title: orchestratectl plan.json (v2)
description: The interface contract the spec-node writes and the supervisor + orchestrator read. Immutable per revision, versioned, provenance-bearing. See issues/code-pipeline/plan-schema.md and design.md §4/§7/§13. This schema is the checked-in machine-readable artifact; the operative source of truth for readers/writers is the octl_core::plan Rust validator, and a drift-guard test keeps the two in agreement.

schema_version.description: Major schema version. Readers reject unsupported majors (do NOT silently ignore).

plan_rev.description: Immutable revision of this plan. A fix or re-spec writes plan.v(N+1).json; each chunk attempt records the plan_rev it consumed.

intent_rev.description: The orchestrator-owned intent.md revision this plan targets. Intent is referenced, not embedded.

baseline.description: Snapshot at feat/<slug> fork; verify + the deterministic floor diff against it. Supervisor-owned.

commit_oid.description: Ref resolved to an immutable commit OID at capture time (floor provenance; additive-optional).

toolchain.description: rustc -V fingerprint the snapshot was captured with (floor provenance; additive-optional).

enumerated_targets_hash.description: Hash of the enumerated (package, target_kind, target) test-target set (floor F7 superset check; additive-optional).

acceptance.description: Whole-feature intent gate. Each item is an executable check or an LLM-judged assertion; at least one must be a check.

chunks.description: The DAG of implementation chunks. deps form an acyclic dependency graph.

cwd.description: Optional working directory to run `run` in; absent = worktree root. Must be a safe repo-relative path (no absolute paths, `~`, `..`, backslash, `:`, control chars, or a bare `.`) — enforced by the octl_core::plan validator, as for files_touched.

expect_exit.description: Optional expected exit code; the check passes iff the command exits with it. Absent = 0. A shell exit status is 0..=255.

check.description: An executable check: the general goal (desc) plus a flexible shell command (run), with optional cwd/expect_exit precision. Precision is available, not forced.

desc.description: The general goal of the check — what it verifies. Always present.

run.description: A flexible shell command executed via `sh -c`.

cwd.description: Optional working directory to run `run` in; absent = worktree root. Must be a safe repo-relative path (no absolute paths, `~`, `..`, backslash, `:`, control chars, or a bare `.`) — enforced by the octl_core::plan validator, as for files_touched.

expect_exit.description: Optional expected exit code; the check passes iff the command exits with it. Absent = 0. A shell exit status is 0..=255.

id.description: Unique within the plan; referenced by other chunks' deps.

deps.description: Ids of chunks this one depends on. Every entry must reference an existing chunk; entries must be unique; the graph must be acyclic (acyclicity is enforced by the Rust validator, not expressible in JSON Schema).

tier.description: Starting model tier hint; the orchestrator owns promotion.

files_touched.description: Merge-time constraint (not just a hint): repo-relative paths, no traversal.

checks.description: Executable per-chunk checks; at least one required.

assertions.description: LLM-judged criteria, additive above the deterministic floor. Each must be a non-empty string (the Rust validator additionally rejects whitespace-only strings).

requires_tests.description: If true, the supervisor blocks a merge that added/modified no tests.
